radiusSource: Radius 0.293 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Lee et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6324 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...983L..36L/abstract): 203,840 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.269 +/- 0.012 solar masses from Lee et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6324 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...983L..36L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3247 +/- 70 K from Lee et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6324 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...983L..36L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
